description: This file defines the LoanInterestAccrual class and related functions for managing loan interest accruals, including validation, journal entry creation, and interest calculation for demand and term loans within the ERPNext system.

classes.name: LoanInterestAccrual
classes.description: Model representing a loan interest accrual record, handling validation, journal entries, and submission within the ERP system.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the loan interest accrual data before submission.

methods.name: on_submit
methods.description: Creates general ledger entries upon submission.

methods.name: on_cancel
methods.description: Reverses ledger entries and updates repayment schedule on cancellation.

methods.name: update_is_accrued
methods.description: Marks the repayment schedule as accrued.

methods.name: make_gl_entries
methods.description: Generates and posts GL entries for interest accrual.
